name: Platinenwerk Lausitz GmbH
summary: Platinenwerk Lausitz is a privately owned PCBA maker founded in 1991, with 320 staff, EUR 88 M turnover and stable, sound finances. It is our only source for the HB smart pump control board, and we are only 0.7 % of its turnover. After four years of settling 'below full cost to keep the volume', it has given formal notice of +8.0 % (EUR 34.35 → 37.10) from 2027-01-01. Meanwhile its delivery and quality performance is slipping (OTD 85.7 % against a 95 % target, ppm up from 322 to 701).

situation.decision_maker: Key account manager up to 2 %; anything above 2 % goes to their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks

negotiation_pattern: Asks modestly and settles about 2 points below its ask: mean asked +0.93 %, mean settled -1.13 %. In 2026 it asked +2.1 % and got +0.4 %; in 2025 -0.5 → -2.0 %; in 2024 +1.2 → -1.8 %. Every event is noted 'accepted below full cost to keep the volume'. This year breaks the pattern: an +8 % letter, sent formally and inside the contract's 90-day notice window, which signals the margin squeeze has reached its limit. Expect it to concede from 8 %, but a much harder stance than before against flat refusal.
wants: A real price correction (it has been below its own cost for years)
Protection against copper and component cost swings (index or pass-through mechanism)
Payment on time (we pay late on 88 % of invoices)
protects: unit_price: will not accept 0 % or a reduction again this time
Any settlement above 2 %, which needs pricing committee sign-off and slows the KAM down
effective_date 2027-01-01, since notice was validly given under clause 3.1

trades.give: index_clause: copper/component index on the material share (~55 % of cost), with a deadband
trades.get: Fixed base increase of ≤2 % for 2027 instead of 8 %
trades.why: Turns its stated cost driver into a transparent mechanism and keeps the base move within KAM authority (no committee).

trades.give: Pay strictly on the 45-day due date, or payment_days shortened to 30
trades.get: Lower increase or a later effective_date (e.g. 2027-04-01)
trades.why: We pay late 88 % of the time (mean +4.4 days), so on-time payment is a cheap, credible give for us.

trades.give: contract_months: extend the framework beyond 2027-06-30 (e.g. +24 months), plus a rolling forecast at ~18.5k pcs/year
trades.get: Increase capped well below 8 %, plus a price hold for the extension period
trades.why: Volume security has been its stated reason to accept low prices in every past event.

trades.get: ppm_commitment (back to ≤350), an OTD recovery plan toward 95 %, closure of the 2 open 8Ds, and a higher chargeback_eur_per_complaint
trades.why: Ties any increase to reversing a clear quality and delivery decline.

arguments.point: Performance does not justify 8 %. OTD is 85.7 % against the contractual 95 % target, ppm has more than doubled from 322 to 701, 13 complaints were logged in the latest period, and 2 8Ds are still open.
The letter claims copper and component cost increases but gives no figures. Ask for a cost breakdown (material/conversion) before any committee decision.
We have been a steady A-part customer at ~EUR 600-675k a year for three years and want a long-term, predictable arrangement rather than one-off jumps.
Propose a solution the KAM can sign alone: ≤2 % base plus an index mechanism, which avoids the pricing committee cycle.

avoid: Flat refusal or demanding a reduction: our price is ~7.8 % below its estimated own cost, and as a sole source it can deprioritise us at 0.7 % of its turnover.
Threatening to resource: there are 0 other sources, a PCBA requalification is slow, and the threat is not credible.
Leaning on our should-cost figure as hard fact: its confidence is only 5 %.
Raising payment discipline as our strength: we are the late payer here.
Claiming the notice was invalid: it was sent 2026-09-19, inside the 90-day window of clause 3.1.
tone: Respectful and partnership-oriented. Acknowledge the cost pressure, be firm and factual on quality data, and offer a structured package rather than haggling.
red_flags: Single source (100 % quota, no alternative) for an A-class PCBA, with high supply risk if talks sour.
Price is below its estimated cost after four below-cost settlements, so the risk of a sustained margin squeeze leading to deprioritisation or walk-away is real.
Quality is deteriorating: ppm 322 → 701, OTD 85.7 % against the 95 % target, 2 open 8Ds, last complaint 2026-09-22.
Lead time is 56 days, so any disruption hits pump output fast.
Framework auto-extends from 2027-06-30 unless terminated with 90 days' notice, giving either side an exit window in early 2027.

evidence.claim: Asks +8.0 % (EUR 34.35 → 37.10) from 2027-01-01, citing copper and component prices.
The KAM can only approve price changes up to 2 %; above that the pricing committee decides, meeting every two weeks.
Current price is 7.8 % below the bottom-up own-plant cost of 37.24, though that estimate has only 5 % confidence.
Every past event settled about 2 points below its ask, each noted as accepted below full cost to keep the volume.
OTD is 85.7 % and ppm 701, worsening from ppm 322; the scorecard is still green, class A.
Contract terms: prices fixed per calendar year with 90-day notice for changes; 45 days net; OTD target 95 %; EUR 150 per complaint.
Framework runs to 2027-06-30 and auto-extends 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice.
